title: A new {site} for {settlement}
The {site} is spent
summary: The {site} of {settlement} is worked out. {giver} needs someone to find a new one, {distance} from the town.
offer: There is nothing left in the old {site} but dust and puddles. Find us another — walk the country round, and when you stand on good ground, you will know. {distance} out.
complete: A good find. The crew goes out tomorrow to open it. This town owes you its living.
